title: Astrid and the Protocol
author: Rafael Galloway
blurb: Orsen Brightwater, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
